methods.name: PrefixMaxima
methods.header:
method PrefixMaxima(s: seq<int>) returns (p: seq<int>)
  ensures |p| == |s|
  ensures forall k, j :: 0 <= j <= k < |s| ==> s[j] <= p[k]
  ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |s| ==> exists j :: 0 <= j <= k && p[k] == s[j]

mutants.violation: Two distinct semantic defects: zero initialization invents a value absent from positive prefixes; less-than update computes a running minimum instead of maximum

defects.description: zero initialization invents a value absent from positive prefixes
less-than update computes a running minimum instead of maximum

representations.natural: [R1] The result p has the same length as s, including empty input. [R2] At each valid index k, p[k] is at least every input element from index zero through k inclusive. [R3] At each valid index k, p[k] equals an input element at some index j between zero and k inclusive.
